items.stem: Which best describes the purpose of a user story?

options.text: A short placeholder that prompts a conversation about a need
options.rationale: Correct: stories capture intent and trigger discussion, not full specs.
Stories deliberately avoid being exhaustive up-front specs.

options.text: A technical design document for developers
options.rationale: Design is separate; a story expresses user value.

options.text: A fixed contract that cannot change
options.rationale: Stories are refined and can change as understanding grows.

items.explanation: Correct: stories capture intent and trigger discussion, not full specs.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which statements about splitting a large story are correct? (Select TWO)

options.text: Each slice should still deliver observable user value
options.rationale: Correct: vertical slices keep each piece valuable and demonstrable.

options.text: Splitting should keep stories small enough to finish in one iteration
options.rationale: Correct: right-sized stories improve flow and feedback.

options.text: Stories should be split by technical layer such as 'the database part'
options.rationale: Layer splits produce pieces with no standalone user value.

options.text: A split story must never have acceptance criteria
options.rationale: Every story, including slices, needs acceptance criteria.

items.explanation: Correct: vertical slices keep each piece valuable and demonstrable.

items.stem: A story is marked 'done' although two of its five acceptance criteria are unmet. What principle is violated?

options.text: Definition of done requires all acceptance criteria to be satisfied
options.rationale: Correct: partial completion is not done and hides remaining work.
They define what done means for the story.

options.text: Done means the developer feels finished
options.rationale: Done is defined by agreed criteria, not personal judgement.

options.text: Stories should not have acceptance criteria
options.rationale: Criteria are essential to judging completion.

items.explanation: Correct: partial completion is not done and hides remaining work.
